🚪Welcome to +1 Speed Meme Soundboard Escape | Backrooms 🚪

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed
👟 Run, jump, and escape across the backrooms on meme soundboard keys
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Become the FASTEST on the server
🚀 Speed is everything… but one wrong move and you’re back at the start 😱

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying soundboard clicks, backrooms visuals, and exciting meme sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill ✨
